properties.entry: SELECT M.USER_NUM, U.USER_NICKNAME, NVL(SUM(T.TRANS_AMOUNT), 0) AS SPENT_AMOUNT FROM GROUP_MEMBERS M JOIN USERS U ON M.USER_NUM = U.USER_NUM LEFT JOIN GROUP_TRANSACTIONS T ON M.GROUP_NUM = T.GROUP_NUM AND M.USER_NUM = T.USER_NUM AND T.PERIOD_NUM = ? AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE M.GROUP_NUM = ? AND M.MEMBER_STATUS = 'A' GROUP BY M.USER_NUM, U.USER_NICKNAME

SELECT S.SETTLE_AMOUNT, P.USER_NICKNAME AS PAYER_NICKNAME, R.USER_NICKNAME AS RECEIVER_NICKNAME FROM SETTLEMENT_SNAPSHOTS S JOIN USERS P ON S.PAYER_USER_NUM = P.USER_NUM JOIN USERS R ON S.RECEIVER_USER_NUM = R.USER_NUM WHERE S.PERIOD_NUM = ? ORDER BY S.SETTLE_NUM ASC
